verdict.rationale: Temporal supports Signals (external events into running workflows) and Schedules (time-based triggers), and a single Workflow's Activities can fan out to many downstream calls, but there is no evidence of declarative webhook/queue-trigger bindings that start workflows purely from configuration — starting a Workflow from an external event still requires writing client-SDK code to call StartWorkflowExecution or Signal. Missing for 10: documented declarative webhook/event-source-to-workflow trigger mappings, native queue-consumer trigger bindings, and evidence of one-event-to-many-workflows fan-out as a first-class declarative feature.
